sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on a floating rate loan granted for purposes other than business to an individual that was sanctioned on 2026-03-01.
The directions apply to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, and the case facts place the sanction date on 2026-03-01.
The documents do not state any floating-rate exception for this case beyond paragraph 261(1), and paragraph 261(5) applies only to cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2).

missing.searched: Whether a UCB may levy pre-payment charges on a floating rate loan to an individual for non-business purposes sanctioned in March 2026
